title: Energy source selection
document: This meeting was mainly about conceptual design. Industrial Designer, Marketing and User Interface gave presentations mainly on component design, current trend and interface design respectively, based on their research on the website incorporating the ideas from last meeting. A lot of discussions was centred around the fruit and vegetable theme, which was the current marketing trend. In the meanwhile, they had some discussions on physical attributes and the use of energy. They agreed that the screen was not necessary, and TV could be used as the screen instead. In addition, Kryptonite became their preferred energy.

decisions.decision: Kryptonite was chosen as the preferred energy source.
rationale: The chip is the most expensive part regardless, so the energy source's own cost is a secondary concern.
conditions: The exact price of kryptonite was never established -- the website did not give an actual cost.
dissent: The Industrial Designer preferred a battery and was skeptical of the dynamo.
